label: Doorway · 1 m door in a wall across the room
description: Studio's offset-doorway demo arena rebuilt as a wall across the whole room: two 2 m high walls at x = 2 m from |y| = 0.5 m to 8 m, past the edge of the planner's 12 x 12 m memory, so the 1 m door (|y| < 0.5 m) is the only way to the far side the planner can know about. The original arena's 1.8 m walls, and a first rebuild with 0.8 m door and walls to |y| = 5 m, could both be walked around.

provenance.changed: rebuilt for the site, 2026-10-21: 1 m door, walls past the memory edge
